values.body:
In the admin, **Save draft** keeps your changes without changing the site, and **Publish** puts the draft live. An entry’s badge says whether it’s a draft, published, or changed since it was published.

## How the site finds out

The site caches what it reads from the CMS. Publishing anything runs the **Revalidate the site** automation, which calls the site’s `/api/revalidate` with a signed request, and the site reads the CMS again on the next visit.

## Settings

Settings have no drafts, so every save goes live. That suits a site’s name and navigation, which editors expect to change at once.
values.title: Drafts, publishing and the site

values.excerpt: Save keeps a draft, Publish puts it live, and the site updates itself.
